title: Terrible milk frothed design/process
text:
Terrible milk frothed design/process. I have to say that if I hadn't been using my Saeco automatic espresso machine for two years, I would probably love this machine. However, in a side by side comparison for two weeks, I much prefer the Saeco for several reasons. If I had to replace my Saeco, it wouldn't be with this DeLonghi.

This machine is bigger, far more complicated and delicate than my other espresso machine and it is significantly slower. This unit does hold more water, but fewer beans. This one does have a specific setting for iced brew, but it tastes exactly the same as when I just make a lungo over ice in the Saeco - so nothing special there.

In side by side use, the DeLonghi is significantly quieter than the Saeco and that's a plus early in the morning. However, it literally took seven minutes to brew a simple lungo from start to finish - my other machine had already finished and I was drinking that coffee before this one finished. I will say the DeLonghi does offer a finer grind and a slightly smoother finish using the same beans, but both coffees tasted good.

My primary complaint is the ridiculous way this machine does milk for a cappuccino or latte. It's manual and you have to provide your own container. The wand goes directly in the milk and you have to lift and twist your container to get all the milk steamed/frothed. Then you have to pour it into your pre-made coffee and stir... Ummmm no. That's not automatic in any way shape or form. My Saeco has its own pitcher and the machine forces the milk through the steamer and directly into the cup and then the coffee is added - you get a hot cup of coffee with hot milk and real foam all at the same time. That one thing is reason enough to put this machine in the closet as an emergency back up in the event our good Saeco dies.

product_metadata.title: De'Longhi ECAM35020W Dinamica Automatic Coffee & Espresso Machine Iced-Coffee, Burr Grinder + Descaling Solution
features: Note: 1)Too coarse a grind, too little coffee, or insufficiently tamping the grounds before brewing can all lead to inadequate pressure for a proper brew. 2)It is important to note that the amount of espresso extracted will vary depending on the grind size and amount and reprogramming may be needed when the size and amount are adjusted
description: You shouldn't have to settle for a watered-down version of your favorite iced coffee at home. With the world's first and only fully automatic espresso machine with iced coffee technology, you never have to. By brewing at a lower temperature, allowing for pre-infusion (coffee grounds saturation) and offering the ability to customize to extra strong, De'Longhi Dinamica brews smooth, full-bodied coffee over ice that is never watered down. You can also enjoy a variety of the freshest, traditional coffee beverages at home. An automatic bean-to-cup machine, Dinamica offers easy to brew beverages: espresso, long espresso, drip style coffee, and Over Ice . With an integrated advanced manual frother, espresso with milk classics like lattes and cappuccinos come complete with rich, long-lasting foam whether you use soy, almond, coconut, rice or cow's milk. To deliver the freshest brew possible, the Dinamica's revolutionary technology grinds the perfect amount of your favorite beans, leaving no residual coffee in the brew unit, ensuring your next cup is just as fresh. And cleanup is a snap, taking half the time of other machines. Unlike the competition, no chemicals are needed--just pop out the drip tray and drop it in the dishwasher. Expect every cup to be exactly the way you like it with an automatic touch-sensitive interface. Dinamica features an adjustable steel burr grinder to control the grind and strength depending on the coffee beans origin. It's all designed to keep your daily brew from becoming a daily grind. Frothing quality will vary depending on the type of dairy or non-dairy milk selected. De'Longhi recommends cold skim or 2% dairy milk cold or non-dairy milks that are found in the refrigerator case at the store. What's included: Coffee Espresso Machine Descaling Solution Cleaning Brush Ice Cube Tray (coffee bean shaped) Water Filter Measuring Spoon Instruction Manual & Quick Start Guide 2 Year + 1 addition year if you register your product
